description.value:
A beautiful marriage of Japanese technology and Valentino style.

Category: The major leagues. (Luxury) • Fabrication: DV29 - 5,000eb - 1 Month

Class: Iconic EQ Heavy Pistol • Skill: Handgun • Range: Pistol

Damage: 3d6 • Capacity: 10 • ROF: 2 • Hands: 1

Alt. Firing Modes: None

Concealable: Yes, but at a -2 penalty to Conceal/Reveal Object

Slots: N/A • Attachments: Quick Release, Power Rebuild, Ricochet Compensator • Mods: Fashionista (w/ Superchrome Coating)

Special Features: All ammunition fired by this weapon also functions as Incendiary Ammunition. When using this weapon to make an Aimed Shot, it deals 1d6 additional damage (4d6), or 2d6 additional damage (5d6) if it had dealt damage via an Aimed Shot in the previous Round. Whenever this weapon inflicts a Head Critical Injury, it deals 5 additional Bonus Damage (15 Total). While wielding two copies of this weapon, the user can take the Reload Action with both weapons as a single Action [Quick Release]. Provides a +2 bonus to Wardrobe and Style Checks while worn openly, which does not stack with any other Superchrome-based bonus [Fashionista].

Fabrication: DV29 - 5,000eb - 1 Month
Range: Pistol
Pre-installed: Quick Release, Power Rebuild, Ricochet Compensator (effects already included in these stats)
Mods: Fashionista (w/ Superchrome Coating)

Foundry notes:

  • Iconic weapons follow the Exotic weapon rules: no Non-Basic Ammunition and no Attachment Slots unless this entry says otherwise.
  • Iconic: it can't be bought or sourced on the street, can't be fabricated without its Blueprint, can't be taken during Character Generation, and once acquired can't be destroyed unless the player agrees to it beforehand.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Becoming Iconic > Iconic Weapons).
